entities.name: 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase small subunit
observations: The 204-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry B8G7X5 from Chloroflexus aggregans.
The protein is the small subunit of the 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase complex; Pfam evidence includes Aconitase_C and LeuD-related domains.

entities.name: 2-isopropylmalate isomerization
observations: Catalyzes reversible isomerization of (2R,3S)-3-isopropylmalate to (2S)-2-isopropylmalate via 2-isopropylmaleate.

entities.name: L-leucine biosynthesis
observations: The reaction is step 2 of 4 in the biosynthesis of L-leucine from 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate.
